title: Aristocrats Masterpiece
html_source: Or, “Aristotle’s Masterpiece” a “sex manual and a midwifery book that was popular in England from the early modern period through to the 19th century. It was first published in 1684 and written by an unknown author who falsely claimed to be Aristotle.” (Wikipedia). The book is mentioned at least three times in “Ulysses” (here in Chapter 10) and (here in Chapter 14).
